text: Hino jeyaa e mawngu Allah ngun, tawde kammuuli ɗin e no ɗi foti e waade e toowude, hiɗi eɓɓa seekorgol dow leydi ndin, hara Malaa'ika'en no laɓɓinira Joomi maɓɓe, yettugol Mo, yankinanoo Mo mawnina Mo, ɓe toroo Mo haforangol wonɓe ka leydi ɓen. Awa anndee pellet, ko Allah woni Haforanoowo kala tuubuɗo e jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
